temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. He invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines, citing too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is a dedicated hospital worker and friend, but Ethan is already worried that Gary may be pushing himself too hard.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's refusal and stated workload confirm that his overwork is severe and that he feels unable to step away.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is overworked and at risk, and his hospital obligations make him resistant to taking time for rest.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and worried, with some frustration or helplessness.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To intervene by persuading Gary to rest and accept help, despite his initial refusal.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes that Gary is restless and avoids discussing work. Ethan suspects there is more to Gary's overworking than professional obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is overworked because of hospital demands and needs rest, but Ethan thinks the retreat may help him relax.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's restlessness and avoidance suggest that his overwork is driven by something deeper than ordinary professional duty.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary may be hiding personal or emotional problems connected to his overwork.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront Gary gently and offer nonjudgmental support so Gary can open up.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. Ethan learns the reasons behind Gary's overworking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary has deeper personal or professional issues causing his overwork, but Ethan does not yet know the details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's overwork is explained by new departmental pressures combined with personal challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan understands Gary's situation more fully and believes Gary needs help finding a healthier balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule so he can make time for himself.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary. Gary reports progress, says things are better, and mentions having time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is trying to change and has Ethan's support, but he still faces challenges in achieving balance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's reports and behavior show that he is making real progress and beginning to reclaim personal time.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is improving and becoming less overwhelmed; Ethan's support is helping.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, encouraging Gary, and offering support whenever needed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary thanks Ethan and says he feels more in control.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary has been improving steadily, but Ethan still sees himself as an active source of support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary is now managing well on his own and no longer needs Ethan's active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is capable of maintaining a healthier balance independently, and Ethan can step back.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Satisfied and happy for his friend.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back while letting Gary know he is always available if needed.
